sources.title: Nanbeige Releases Nanbeige4.3-33B, a 33B Open Agentic Coding Model
sources.snippet: Nanbeige4.3-33B is a 33B dense language model built for agentic coding and office-style 'cowork' tasks. The lab sits inside the recruitment platform BOSS Zhipin. It also published Nanbeige4.3-33B-Base for custom post-training. The model supports a 524,288-token context window.

sources.title: Nanbeige4.3-33B: Open 33B Agent Model, 80.9 on Terminal-Bench ...
sources.snippet: Nanbeige4.3-33B is a new open-weight dense model released on October 24, 2026 under the Apache 2.0 license, built for coding and office-style agents. The model card on Hugging Face reports that it leads three comparable 30B-class models on most agentic benchmarks, including 80.9 on Terminal-Bench 2.1.
